description: List the alerts turned on in the person's own linked PermitSnag account: each permit or campground, its dates, how often PermitSnag checks it and when it was last checked, plus the alert id that cancel_alert needs. Also lists alerts saved by create_alert that are waiting for a payment, with their payment links. Read only.
name: list_my_alerts

outputSchema.description: The alerts turned on in the person's own linked PermitSnag account.

awaitingPayment.description: Alerts set up here that wait for a payment. Present only when there are some.

label.description: What the link buys, in words.

priceUsd.description: Price in US dollars. The checkout page may show the local currency.

purchase.description: What the link buys: this permit or campground once, or PermitSnag Pro.

url.description: Opens the checkout page for this purchase. The person pays there; nothing is charged from here.

state.description: awaiting_payment: open a link to turn it on. link_expired: ask create_alert again. turning_on: paid, being turned on. needs_help: paid but could not be turned on; contact support.
on: checking now. scheduled: starts checking on scanStartsOn.

title: Your PermitSnag alerts
